title: Rename account_actions_sheet_nav_test.dart's single-account Sign Out test — title claims SignInRoute, assertion checks AccountPickerRoute
rule: TQ-8 / Evans ubiquitous-language consistency (test name must match what it verifies)

evidence.quote: 'Sign Out (single account) → root router.replaceAll([SignInRoute]) — no regression',

why: The testWidgets title says the single-account sign-out case routes to SignInRoute, but the assertion checks AccountPickerRoute — and the test's own inline comment (lines 268-270) shows the author caught the discrepancy while writing it ('Single account: getAllAccounts returns 1 → still AccountPicker path? No — sign-out keeps the account row; the picker is correct with ≥1... The SignInRoute branch is the EMPTY-registry case, covered below') but never renamed the test string. A reader skimming test names for the routing invariant would learn the wrong rule.
recommendation: Rename the test to 'Sign Out (single account) → root router.replaceAll([AccountPickerRoute])' to match its assertion.
acceptance_criteria: The test's title string matches the route type its expect() checks.
